subject: Application: Junior Draftsperson, DOF Perth, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Junior Draftsperson role with DOF in Perth CBD, closing 15 October 2026, via your Workable advert.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design documented in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as project in charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Perth. My drafting is from study rather than paid Australian commercial work, and I have not yet worked on offshore or subsea packages, so I would learn those standards under your Lead Draftsperson.

Your advert asks for an Advanced Diploma path into 2D technical drawings with AutoCAD under mentoring, which is the junior drafting step I want.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
